_verificationNote.appliesTo: Plan year 2026-07-01 onward (RAP's first year of availability). Not indexed to inflation: the $10,000 bracket steps, the $50 dependent reduction, the $50 principal match and the $10 minimum are fixed dollar amounts in statute, so they do NOT change annually. Re-check only when Congress amends the HEA or ED issues a new rule.
_verificationNote.primarySource: 34 C.F.R. § 685.209 as revised by the RISE final rule, 91 Fed. Reg. 23768 (1 May 2026), FR Doc. 2026-08556, effective 1 Jul 2026. Full text: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-05-01/html/2026-08556.htm
_verificationNote.bracketBoundaryRule: § 685.209(b)(2) reads 'More than $X and not more than $Y'. An AGI landing exactly on a $10,000 multiple therefore falls in the LOWER band: $60,000 = 5% = $250/mo; $100,000 = 9%. plans/rap.ts implements this with ceil() and is CORRECT. PRODUCT-SPEC §11.5's floor() pseudocode is wrong. NOTE the opposite convention in tiered-standard-terms.json, whose balance brackets read 'Equal to or greater than $X but less than $Y' — do not harmonise the two.
_verificationNote.whereToRecheck: govinfo.gov FR text above (federalregister.gov and ecfr.gov bot-block automated fetches); ED rulemaking announcements at ed.gov; annual review each 1 July.

parentPlusConsolidationTaintException.note: § 685.209(b)(6)(ii): a consolidation loan that repaid a Parent PLUS loan is NOT an 'excepted consolidation loan' — and therefore IS eligible for RAP — if it 'was being repaid under the ICR, PAYE, or IBR plans on any date on or after July 4, 2025, through and including June 30, 2028'. The borrower asserts this per loan via Loan.repaidUnderIdrInWindow, which defaults to false so the taint applies unless the borrower affirms the condition.
